description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the LocalizedDateFormatter class in the OrangeHRM system, focusing on date localization and formatting with various locales, formats, and caching behaviors.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing date formatting and localization features of LocalizedDateFormatter.

methods.name: testFormatDate
methods.description: Tests the formatting of dates with different formats and locales, verifying correct localization output.

methods.name: dataProviderForFormatDate
methods.description: Provides a variety of test data sets covering short/long days and months, testing various date formats and localizations.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForSameFormat
methods.description: Verifies that date formatting caches results correctly when the format string is the same.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForDifferentFormat
methods.description: Verifies cache behavior when formatting dates with different formats.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithNonLocalizableFormat
methods.description: Ensures that the formatter does not call localization methods when the format does not contain localizable components.
